261	  release-asset-attestation:
262	    name: Release Asset Attestation
263	    # Fork PRs also receive a read-only GITHUB_TOKEN and only lack secrets; same-repo-only is a cost/policy choice.
264	    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
265	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
266	    timeout-minutes: 45
267	    permissions:
268	      contents: read
269	    env:
270	      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
271	      ASSET: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
272	    steps:
273	      - name: Select the latest release
274	        id: latest
275	        run: |
276	          set -euo pipefail
277	          tag=$(gh release list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --exclude-drafts --exclude-pre-releases --limit 30 \
278	            --json tagName,isLatest --jq '.[] | select(.isLatest) | .tagName')
279	          if [[ -z "$tag" ]]; then
280	            echo "::notice::no published release yet; skipping the release asset attestation check"
281	          fi
282	          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
283	      - name: Download the release asset
284	        if: steps.latest.outputs.tag != ''
285	        env:
286	          TAG: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.tag }}
287	        run: |
288	          set -euo pipefail
289	          gh release download "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$ASSET" --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP"
290	          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/$ASSET"
291	      - name: Verify the attestation with the installer's flags
292	        if: steps.latest.outputs.tag != ''
293	        run: |
294	          set -euo pipefail
295	          verify() {
296	            gh attestation verify "$1" \
297	              --repo orin-dx/callisto \
298	              --signer-workflow orin-dx/callisto/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml \
299	              --deny-self-hosted-runners
300	          }
301	          verify "$RUNNER_TEMP/$ASSET"
302	          # Negative control: a modified copy must fail, so the pass above is not vacuous.
303	          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/$ASSET" "$RUNNER_TEMP/tampered.tar.gz"
304	          printf 'x' >> "$RUNNER_TEMP/tampered.tar.gz"
305	          if verify "$RUNNER_TEMP/tampered.tar.gz"; then
306	            echo "::error::negative control failed: attestation verification accepted a tampered copy of $ASSET"
307	            exit 1
308	          fi
309	          echo "negative control passed: the tampered copy was rejected"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Drafts the open managed release PR as soon as main moves, because a draft cannot be merged. The release
3	# workflow marks it ready again only after a refresh built from the new tip, so a failed or skipped refresh
4	# leaves a stale release PR unmergeable instead of mergeable. Usage: hold-release-pr.sh <release-branch>
5	# Needs GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_REPOSITORY.
6	set -euo pipefail
7	
8	release_branch="${1:?usage: hold-release-pr.sh <release-branch>}"
9	
10	prs=$(gh pr list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --limit 1000 --json number,isDraft,headRefName,headRepository)
11	numbers=$(jq -r --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg branch "$release_branch" '
12	  .[] | select(.isDraft == false
13	    and (.headRepository.nameWithOwner // "") == $repo
14	    and (.headRefName == $branch or (.headRefName | startswith($branch + "--")))) | .number' <<< "$prs")
15	
16	for number in $numbers; do
17	  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
18	    if gh pr ready "$number" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --undo; then
19	      echo "::notice::Held release PR #$number as a draft until the release workflow refreshes it"
20	      break
21	    fi
22	    [[ $attempt -lt 3 ]] || { echo "::error::could not draft release PR #$number"; exit 1; }
23	    sleep $((attempt * 2))
24	  done
25	done

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Moves the floating major tag (v1, v2, ...) to a release commit, for a stable release at or past 1.0.0.
3	# Run inside the release-source checkout, after the release succeeded, so `uses: ...@v1` follows the newest 1.x.
4	# Usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]
5	set -euo pipefail
6	
7	decision="${1:?usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]}"
8	package="${2:?missing package}"
9	commit="${3:?missing commit}"
10	remote="${4:-origin}"
11	
12	if [[ ! "$commit" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
13	  echo "::error::commit must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
14	  exit 1
15	fi
16	
17	version=$(jq -r --arg package "$package" '[.entries[] | select(.package == $package) | .targetVersion][0] // empty' "$decision")
18	if [[ -z "$version" ]]; then
19	  echo "$package is not in this release; no floating tag to move"
20	  exit 0
21	fi
22	if [[ ! "$version" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
23	  echo "$version is not a stable X.Y.Z version; no floating tag to move"
24	  exit 0
25	fi
26	major="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
27	if ((major < 1)); then
28	  echo "$version is before 1.0.0; no floating tag to move"
29	  exit 0
30	fi
31	tag="v$major"
32	
33	current=$(git ls-remote --tags "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag" | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }')
34	if [[ "$current" == "$commit" ]]; then
35	  echo "$tag already points at $commit"
36	  exit 0
37	fi
38	if [[ -n "$current" ]]; then
39	  # A recovery run of an older release must not drag the tag backwards.
40	  git fetch --quiet "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag" --force
41	  if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$current" "$commit"; then
42	    echo "$tag points at $current, which is not an ancestor of $commit; leaving it"
43	    exit 0
44	  fi
45	fi
46	
47	git tag --force "$tag" "$commit"
48	git push --force "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag"
49	echo "$tag now points at $commit ($package $version)"
50

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Build one declared Callisto product artifact. This script deliberately owns
3	# only platform compilation and archive layout; Callisto owns all release
4	# planning, artifact identity, provenance verification, and publication.
5	set -euo pipefail
6	
7	: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND:?must name cli or cross}"
8	: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET:?must name a supported Rust target}"
9	: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET:?must name the expected release asset}"
10	: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT:?must name the checked-out source root}"
11	: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR:?must name an output directory}"
12	
13	kind="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND"
14	target="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET"
15	asset="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET"
16	source_root="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT"
17	artifact_dir="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR"
18	
19	case "$kind:$target:$asset" in
20	  cli:aarch64-apple-darwin:callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz | \
21	  cli:x86_64-apple-darwin:callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz | \
22	  cli:x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu:callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | \
23	  cli:aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu:callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | \
24	  cross:x86_64-unknown-linux-musl:callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz)
25	    ;;
26	  *)
27	    printf 'unsupported Callisto release artifact: kind=%s target=%s asset=%s\n' \
28	      "$kind" "$target" "$asset" >&2
29	    exit 1
30	    ;;
31	esac
32	
33	mkdir -p "$artifact_dir"
34	
35	case "$kind" in
36	  cli)
37	    rustup target add "$target"
38	    (cd "$source_root" && cargo build --locked --release -p callisto-cli --target "$target")
39	    tar -C "$source_root/target/$target/release" -czf "$artifact_dir/$asset" callisto
40	    ;;
41	  cross)
42	    rustup target add "$target"
43	    cargo install cross --locked --version 0.2.5
44	    (cd "$source_root" && cross build --locked --release -p callisto-cli --target "$target")
45	    tar -C "$source_root/target/$target/release" -czf "$artifact_dir/$asset" callisto
46	    ;;
47	esac

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Executes a typed Callisto release-PR decision. Forge reads stay here; all
3	# create/update policy belongs to `callisto release-pr decide`.
4	#
5	# The managed branch is never pushed with the Git wire protocol: on a public
6	# repository, GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write `.github/workflows/*` that way, nor
7	# through createCommitOnBranch's own fileChanges, on any ref (confirmed
8	# directly against this repository). Instead, the generated
9	# version-bump changes are committed via the forge commit API onto a
10	# deterministic staging branch rooted at the current base commit -- which
11	# never needs to touch `.github/workflows/*`, since that path is inherited
12	# unchanged from the base -- and only then is the managed branch's ref moved
13	# onto that commit. A ref move is not itself a write to that path.
14	set -euo pipefail
15	
16	cd "$INPUT_CWD"
17	
18	# This checkout starts on the configured base. Preserve its exact commit for
19	# both observations; the working tree changes below (git add -A) never
20	# create a local commit -- the real commit is made remotely, via the forge
21	# commit API, on the staging branch.
22	base_commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
23	
24	# One GitHub 5xx must not strand the release PR until the next push to main: retry transient failures,
25	# print every failed attempt's stderr, and leave other failures (404, 422) to the caller. `gh pr create`
26	# is not wrapped, because a retry after an unseen success would fail on the PR it just made.
27	gh_retry() {
28	  local attempt=1 delay=2 err code
29	  err=$(mktemp)
30	  until gh "$@" 2> "$err"; do
31	    code=$?
32	    cat "$err" >&2
33	    if [[ $attempt -ge 4 ]] || ! grep -qiE 'Something went wrong|HTTP 5[0-9]{2}|Bad Gateway|Service Unavailable|Gateway Time|timed? ?out|connection reset|unexpected EOF' "$err"; then
34	      rm -f "$err"
35	      return "$code"
36	    fi
37	    echo "::warning::gh $1 hit a transient GitHub error (attempt $attempt of 4); retrying in ${delay}s" >&2
38	    sleep "$delay"
39	    delay=$((delay * 2))
40	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
41	    [[ -z "${RETRY_RESET:-}" ]] || "$RETRY_RESET" || true
42	  done
43	  cat "$err" >&2
44	  rm -f "$err"
45	}
46	
47	release_pr_snapshot() {
48	  local raw_prs
49	  # Command substitutions do not inherit set -e, so a failed read must stop here, not later in jq.
50	  raw_prs=$(gh_retry pr list --state open --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --limit 1000 --json number,headRefName,headRepository,headRefOid) || return $?
51	  jq -cn \
52	    --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
53	    --arg base_branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" \
54	    --arg base_commit "$base_commit" \
55	    --argjson raw_prs "$raw_prs" \
56	    '{
57	      schemaVersion: 2,
58	      repository: $repository,
59	      baseBranch: $base_branch,
60	      baseCommit: $base_commit,
61	      openPullRequests: [$raw_prs[] | {
62	        number,
63	        headRepository: (.headRepository.nameWithOwner // ""),
64	        headBranch: .headRefName,
65	        headCommit: .headRefOid
66	      }]
67	    }'
68	}
69	
70	# Reads the open PRs first, so a failed read stops with `gh`'s own status instead of becoming an empty --snapshot.
71	verify_current() {
72	  local current
73	  current=$(release_pr_snapshot) || return $?
74	  callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$current" "$@"
75	}
76	
77	snapshot=$(release_pr_snapshot)
78	decision=$(callisto --format json release-pr decide \
79	  --snapshot "$snapshot" \
80	  --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
81	  --base-branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" \
82	  --release-branch "$INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH")
83	decision_kind=$(jq -r '.action.kind' <<< "$decision")
84	
85	# A missing key must stop the run: `jq -r` would print `null`, and the script would then move a branch named null.
86	decision_field() {
87	  jq -er "$1" <<< "$decision" || { echo "::error::Callisto's release PR decision has no $1; refusing to guess" >&2; return 1; }
88	}
89	
90	case "$decision_kind" in
91	  noop)
92	    echo 'hasChangesets=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
93	    echo '::notice::No changesets. This action does not publish, tag, download artifacts, or create releases; use the durable repository workflow.'
94	    exit 0
95	    ;;
96	  create)
97	    release_branch=$(decision_field '.action.branch')
98	    staging_branch=$(decision_field '.action.stagingBranch')
99	    existing_pr=''
100	    ;;
101	  update)
102	    existing_pr=$(decision_field '.action.pullRequestNumber')
103	    release_branch=$(decision_field '.action.branch')
104	    staging_branch=$(decision_field '.action.stagingBranch')
105	    ;;
106	  *) echo "::error::Callisto returned unsupported release PR decision kind: $decision_kind"; exit 1 ;;
107	esac
108	
109	echo 'hasChangesets=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
110	if [[ -n "$existing_pr" ]]; then
111	  existing_body=$(gh_retry pr view "$existing_pr" --json body --jq '.body')
112	  body=$(printf '%s' "$existing_body" | callisto compose-pr-body --existing-body - --branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" --format text)
113	else
114	  body=$(callisto compose-pr-body --branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" --format text)
115	fi
116	
117	read -ra command <<< "$INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND"
118	command+=(--emit-decision "$INPUT_DECISION_PATH")
119	"${command[@]}"
120	git add -A
121	test -n "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo '::error::pending changesets produced no release-PR delta'; exit 1; }
122	
123	plan_file=$(mktemp)
124	callisto --format json release-pr commit-plan --base-commit "$base_commit" --message "$INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" --out "$plan_file"
125	local_tree=$(git write-tree)
126	
127	staging_created=false
128	cleanup_staging() {
129	  if [[ "$staging_created" == true ]]; then
130	    gh api -X DELETE "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" > /dev/null 2>&1 \
131	      || echo "::warning::could not delete staging branch $staging_branch; the next run reclaims this deterministic name"
132	  fi
133	  rm -f "$plan_file" body.json
134	}
135	trap cleanup_staging EXIT
136	
137	# A local diff does not authorize a stale forge write. Re-observe immediately
138	# before mutating the remote branch, then again before moving the managed
139	# ref, then again before GitHub label/PR writes.
140	verify_current > /dev/null
141	
142	reset_staging() {
143	  gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" -F force=true > /dev/null 2>&1
144	}
145	
146	if reset_staging; then
147	  :
148	else
149	  gh_retry api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" > /dev/null
150	fi
151	staging_created=true
152	
153	jq -n \
154	  --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
155	  --arg branch "$staging_branch" \
156	  --arg headline "$INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" \
157	  --slurpfile plan "$plan_file" \
158	  '{
159	    query: "mutation($input: CreateCommitOnBranchInput!) { createCommitOnBranch(input: $input) { commit { oid } } }",
160	    variables: {
161	      input: {
162	        branch: {repositoryNameWithOwner: $repo, branchName: $branch},
163	        message: {headline: $headline},
164	        expectedHeadOid: $plan[0].baseCommit,
165	        fileChanges: {
166	          additions: [$plan[0].additions[] | {path, contents: .contentsBase64}],
167	          deletions: $plan[0].deletions
168	        }
169	      }
170	    }
171	  }' > body.json
172	
173	# A retry may follow a commit the forge made but never acknowledged, which would fail the mutation's
174	# expectedHeadOid, so each retry first puts the staging branch back on the base commit.
175	new_sha=$(RETRY_RESET=reset_staging gh_retry api graphql --input body.json --jq '.data.createCommitOnBranch.commit.oid')
176	remote_tree=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/commits/$new_sha" --jq '.tree.sha')
177	if [[ "$remote_tree" != "$local_tree" ]]; then
178	  echo "::error::forge commit tree $remote_tree does not match the locally staged tree $local_tree; refusing to move $release_branch"
179	  exit 1
180	fi
181	
182	verify_current > /dev/null
183	
184	if [[ "$decision_kind" == update ]]; then
185	  gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
186	else
187	  if ! gh_retry api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
188	    gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
189	  fi
190	fi
191	moved_sha=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" --jq '.object.sha')
192	if [[ "$moved_sha" != "$new_sha" ]]; then
193	  echo "::error::$release_branch points at $moved_sha after the update, expected $new_sha; a concurrent write may have raced this run"
194	  exit 1
195	fi
196	
197	if [[ "$decision_kind" == update ]]; then
198	  # The PR list can lag a ref move by a moment, and a stale read looks like a changed snapshot.
199	  # A real concurrent change stays visible, so the last attempt still fails.
200	  verified=false
201	  for _ in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9; do
202	    if verify_current --applied-head "$new_sha" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
203	      verified=true
204	      break
205	    fi
206	    sleep 3
207	  done
208	  if [[ "$verified" != true ]]; then
209	    verify_current --applied-head "$new_sha" > /dev/null
210	  fi
211	else
212	  verify_current > /dev/null
213	fi
214	
215	label_exists=$(gh_retry label list --limit 1000 --json name --jq 'any(.[]; .name == env.INPUT_PR_LABEL)')
216	if [[ "$label_exists" != true ]]; then
217	  gh_retry label create "$INPUT_PR_LABEL" --color 0e8a16 --description 'Callisto release packages'
218	fi
219	
220	case "$decision_kind" in
221	  create)
222	    # Born a draft, so a failed tip check below leaves it unmergeable rather than ready on a stale base.
223	    create_args=(--draft --head "$release_branch" --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL")
224	    pr_url=$(gh pr create "${create_args[@]}")
225	    echo "$pr_url"
226	    pr_number=${pr_url##*/}
227	    ;;
228	  update)
229	    edit_args=(--title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --add-label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL")
230	    gh_retry pr edit "$existing_pr" "${edit_args[@]}"
231	    pr_number=$existing_pr
232	    ;;
233	esac
234	
235	# The hold workflow drafts the release PR whenever main moves, because a draft cannot be merged. Hand it back only
236	# when it was built from the current tip; if main moved again during this run, it stays a draft for the next run.
237	is_draft=$(gh_retry pr view "$pr_number" --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft')
238	tip=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/$INPUT_BRANCH" --jq '.object.sha')
239	if [[ "$tip" == "$base_commit" ]]; then
240	  if [[ "$is_draft" == true ]]; then gh_retry pr ready "$pr_number"; fi
241	else
242	  echo "::warning::$INPUT_BRANCH moved to $tip while this run built the release PR from $base_commit; leaving it a draft for the next run"
243	  if [[ "$is_draft" != true ]]; then gh_retry pr ready "$pr_number" --undo; fi
244	fi

# print every failed attempt's stderr, and leave other failures (404, 422) to the caller. `gh pr create`
# is not wrapped, because a retry after an unseen success would fail on the PR it just made.
gh_retry() {
  local attempt=1 delay=2 err code
  err=$(mktemp)

    code=$?

    if [[ $attempt -ge 4 ]] || ! grep -qiE 'Something went wrong|HTTP 5[0-9]{2}|Bad Gateway|Service Unavailable|Gateway Time|timed? ?out|connection reset|unexpected EOF' "$err"; then
      rm -f "$err"
      return "$code"
    fi
    echo "::warning::gh $1 hit a transient GitHub error (attempt $attempt of 4); retrying in ${delay}s" >&2
    sleep "$delay"

    attempt=$((attempt + 1))

        headCommit: .headRefOid

  --base-branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" \

  verified=false

tip=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/$INPUT_BRANCH" --jq '.object.sha')
if [[ "$tip" == "$base_commit" ]]; then
  if [[ "$is_draft" == true ]]; then gh_retry pr ready "$pr_number"; fi

  echo "::warning::$INPUT_BRANCH moved to $tip while this run built the release PR from $base_commit; leaving it a draft for the next run"
  if [[ "$is_draft" != true ]]; then gh_retry pr ready "$pr_number" --undo; fi
fi

name: Callisto Quality Sweeps

# Slow checks that find what the per-PR gates cannot: parsers fed hostile input, and tests that pass without asserting
# anything. They report; they do not block a merge.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "41 3 * * 0"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  fuzz:
    name: Fuzz ${{ matrix.target }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target: [manifest_editor, manifest_identity, parse_changeset, parse_package_id]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-fuzz
      - name: Install nightly
        run: rustup toolchain install nightly --profile minimal
      - name: Fuzz for ten minutes
        working-directory: fuzz
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
        run: cargo +nightly fuzz run "$TARGET" -- -max_total_time=600
      - name: Keep the crashing input
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fuzz-crash-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: fuzz/artifacts/${{ matrix.target }}
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  mutants:
    name: Mutants, shard ${{ matrix.shard }} of 6
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-mutants
      # A surviving mutant means a change to that line would pass every test: report it, do not fail the sweep.
      - name: Mutate the libraries that hold the parsing and version rules
        env:
          SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
        run: cargo mutants -p callisto-model -p callisto-manifests --shard "$SHARD/6" --timeout 120 || [ $? -eq 2 ]
      - name: Summarize
        if: always()
        run: |
          {
            echo "### Surviving mutants, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}"
            if [ -f mutants.out/missed.txt ]; then

87:## Release identity and recovery
94:A recovery is a new run using current orchestration and the merged release PR's full source SHA. It does not rerun historical workflow code or invent a newer version. Callisto's own workflow asks [`callisto release pending`](#finding-releases-that-did-not-finish) for the oldest unfinished release on each main push. It verifies that SHA against the merged managed PR and the current main history before planning. After a release executes, the workflow dispatches the next unfinished one, or refreshes the release PR for newer changesets when none remains.
96:To retry a failed run for the same source, use "Re-run failed jobs" or dispatch the workflow on main with `release_source_sha=<merged PR merge SHA>`. Matching completed effects are adopted; conflicting or uncertain results stop the run. A receipt is written only after every selected operation succeeds. The merge SHA is available in the PR's merge commit and does not depend on a proposed version tag. Release runs execute one at a time: a push during a release waits, then finds nothing pending. A dispatch with an explicit SHA queued behind a push can be replaced by it, so dispatch it again if it did not start.
98:A failed release is selected again on every main push until it finishes, which also holds back the release PR refresh. content.content:
55	Pin the Callisto actions by commit with the version in a comment, such as `uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@<sha> # callisto@1.0.0`. The action installs the release that commit belongs to. From 1.0.0 the floating tag `v1` also works (`@v1`): each stable 1.x release moves it to its release commit, never backwards, and the action installs that release. A mutable tag is only as safe as the repository that moves it, so a pinned commit stays the stricter choice.
56	
57	Build-matrix limits:
58	
59	- An addon crate outside the napi package directory needs a unique crate whose lib name matches `napi.binaryName` (E204).
60	- Generated `.node` files must be gitignored; release execution requires a clean checkout.
61	- Cargo `bin` targets build with `cargo build --release --locked`. Other products, such as `cdylib`s, need a manual workflow.
62	- The napi build and placement roster comes from the release intent, so an unrelated addon does not block a release of another package.
63	- Native npm lifecycle hooks run unchanged, including any owner-defined publishing or forge effects. Those effects are outside Callisto's release graph.
64	
65	---
66	
67	## Release PR and approval
68	
69	The generated workflow keeps a release PR current. Merging that PR to the protected default branch authorizes publication; Callisto adds no approval step. Require reviews and CI checks in branch protection. A CODEOWNERS file alone does not enforce review.
70	
71	The action's `version-pr` mode updates the PR; `release` runs `callisto release` for simple workspaces. Artifact and platform packages use plan/build/execute. See the [action inputs](../.github/actions/callisto-action/action.yml).
72	
73	Only `execute` receives registry credentials. Keep `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN`, `NPM_TOKEN`, and `TWINE_PASSWORD` out of workflow scope, planning and build jobs, and action inputs.
74	
75	After a failed committed-decision CI release, "Re-run failed jobs" adopts completed effects and performs the rest. A green workflow alone is not proof of publication: check the receipt and providers.
76	
77	## PR pre-flight verification
78	
79	[`.github/actions/callisto-validate/action.yml`](../.github/actions/callisto-validate/action.yml) is a reusable action for your PR workflow:
80	
81	- `callisto status --check` — one gate covering config health, package discovery, and changeset syntax: exit 0 with no error-level diagnostics, exit 1 otherwise.
82	- `callisto release --dry-run --format text` — simulates the release plan without effect.
83	- Writes a workspace status summary to the job's GitHub Actions summary page.
84	
85	---
86	
87	## Release identity and recovery
88	
89	Every release run records two different revisions:
90	
91	- The **orchestration revision**: the workflow and Callisto CLI that coordinate the run.
92	- The **release-source revision**: the merged release commit whose exact versions are released.
93	
94	A recovery is a new run using current orchestration and the merged release PR's full source SHA. It does not rerun historical workflow code or invent a newer version. Callisto's own workflow asks [`callisto release pending`](#finding-releases-that-did-not-finish) for the oldest unfinished release on each main push. It verifies that SHA against the merged managed PR and the current main history before planning. After a release executes, the workflow dispatches the next unfinished one, or refreshes the release PR for newer changesets when none remains.
95	
96	To retry a failed run for the same source, use "Re-run failed jobs" or dispatch the workflow on main with `release_source_sha=<merged PR merge SHA>`. Matching completed effects are adopted; conflicting or uncertain results stop the run. A receipt is written only after every selected operation succeeds. The merge SHA is available in the PR's merge commit and does not depend on a proposed version tag. Release runs execute one at a time: a push during a release waits, then finds nothing pending. A dispatch with an explicit SHA queued behind a push can be replaced by it, so dispatch it again if it did not start.
97	
98	A failed release is selected again on every main push until it finishes, which also holds back the release PR refresh. To get past one you finished by hand, push its missing tags, or run `callisto release pending --from <newer release sha>`. Otherwise recover it with a dispatch of its SHA (see [recovering an older release](#recovering-an-older-release)). Finish an older unpublished release before merging a newer release PR: the newer one publishes without any warning that the older version was never tagged.
99	
100	Callisto waits for a published version to appear before it announces anything: up to 6 minutes for npm and PyPI, 2 for Cargo. npm packages are published back to back and waited for together, so a release of many npm packages waits once, not once per package; Cargo and PyPI publishes are waited for as they are published. If the registry is slower it stops with E157; re-run the failed job once the version shows, or set `confirm-timeout` on the registry in `callisto.toml` (see [configuration](config.md#registries)) and keep the job's `timeout-minutes` above the total wait.
101	
102	## Finding releases that did not finish
103	
104	`callisto release pending` lists the merged release commits whose release did not finish, oldest first, with what is missing. It reads each release commit's committed decision and checks that every package has its tag and every GitHub release is published, so it needs no checkout of the old commit and publishes nothing. A release publishes to the registries before it tags, so a missing tag means the release stopped early.
105	
106	```sh
107	callisto release pending                    # text
108	callisto --format json release pending      # for a workflow
109	callisto release pending --from <sha>       # skip an older release that cannot finish

Pin the Callisto actions by commit with the version in a comment, such as `uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@<sha> # callisto@1.0.0`. The action installs the release that commit belongs to. From 1.0.0 the floating tag `v1` also works (`@v1`): each stable 1.x release moves it to its release commit, never backwards, and the action installs that release. A mutable tag is only as safe as the repository that moves it, so a pinned commit stays the stricter choice.

Build-matrix limits:

- An addon crate outside the napi package directory needs a unique crate whose lib name matches `napi.binaryName` (E204).
- Generated `.node` files must be gitignored; release execution requires a clean checkout.
- Cargo `bin` targets build with `cargo build --release --locked`. Other products, such as `cdylib`s, need a manual workflow.
- The napi build and placement roster comes from the release intent, so an unrelated addon does not block a release of another package.
- Native npm lifecycle hooks run unchanged, including any owner-defined publishing or forge effects. Those effects are outside Callisto's release graph.

---

## Release PR and approval

The generated workflow keeps a release PR current. Merging that PR to the protected default branch authorizes publication; Callisto adds no approval step. Require reviews and CI checks in branch protection. A CODEOWNERS file alone does not enforce review.

The action's `version-pr` mode updates the PR; `release` runs `callisto release` for simple workspaces. Artifact and platform packages use plan/build/execute. See the [action inputs](../.github/actions/callisto-action/action.yml).

Only `execute` receives registry credentials. Keep `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN`, `NPM_TOKEN`, and `TWINE_PASSWORD` out of workflow scope, planning and build jobs, and action inputs.

After a failed committed-decision CI release, "Re-run failed jobs" adopts completed effects and performs the rest. A green workflow alone is not proof of publication: check the receipt and providers.

## PR pre-flight verification

[`.github/actions/callisto-validate/action.yml`](../.github/actions/callisto-validate/action.yml) is a reusable action for your PR workflow:

- `callisto status --check` — one gate covering config health, package discovery, and changeset syntax: exit 0 with no error-level diagnostics, exit 1 otherwise.
- `callisto release --dry-run --format text` — simulates the release plan without effect.
- Writes a workspace status summary to the job's GitHub Actions summary page.

---

## Release identity and recovery

Every release run records two different revisions:

- The **orchestration revision**: the workflow and Callisto CLI that coordinate the run.
- The **release-source revision**: the merged release commit whose exact versions are released.

A recovery is a new run using current orchestration and the merged release PR's full source SHA. It does not rerun historical workflow code or invent a newer version. Callisto's own workflow asks [`callisto release pending`](#finding-releases-that-did-not-finish) for the oldest unfinished release on each main push. It verifies that SHA against the merged managed PR and the current main history before planning. After a release executes, the workflow dispatches the next unfinished one, or refreshes the release PR for newer changesets when none remains.

To retry a failed run for the same source, use "Re-run failed jobs" or dispatch the workflow on main with `release_source_sha=<merged PR merge SHA>`. Matching completed effects are adopted; conflicting or uncertain results stop the run. A receipt is written only after every selected operation succeeds. The merge SHA is available in the PR's merge commit and does not depend on a proposed version tag. Release runs execute one at a time: a push during a release waits, then finds nothing pending. A dispatch with an explicit SHA queued behind a push can be replaced by it, so dispatch it again if it did not start.

A failed release is selected again on every main push until it finishes, which also holds back the release PR refresh. To get past one you finished by hand, push its missing tags, or run `callisto release pending --from <newer release sha>`. Otherwise recover it with a dispatch of its SHA (see [recovering an older release](#recovering-an-older-release)). Finish an older unpublished release before merging a newer release PR: the newer one publishes without any warning that the older version was never tagged.

Callisto waits for a published version to appear before it announces anything: up to 6 minutes for npm and PyPI, 2 for Cargo. npm packages are published back to back and waited for together, so a release of many npm packages waits once, not once per package; Cargo and PyPI publishes are waited for as they are published. If the registry is slower it stops with E157; re-run the failed job once the version shows, or set `confirm-timeout` on the registry in `callisto.toml` (see [configuration](config.md#registries)) and keep the job's `timeout-minutes` above the total wait.

## Finding releases that did not finish

`callisto release pending` lists the merged release commits whose release did not finish, oldest first, with what is missing. It reads each release commit's committed decision and checks that every package has its tag and every GitHub release is published, so it needs no checkout of the old commit and publishes nothing. A release publishes to the registries before it tags, so a missing tag means the release stopped early.

```sh
callisto release pending                    # text
callisto --format json release pending      # for a workflow
callisto release pending --from <sha>       # skip an older release that cannot finish
```

Recover each one with the dispatch below, oldest first.

## A stale release PR

Callisto's workflow rebuilds the release PR on every push to `main`. While that rebuild is pending the PR is stale: if changesets changed on `main` since it was built, merging it releases the wrong set. So a second workflow, `Hold release PR`, turns the open release PR into a draft the moment `main` moves, and the release workflow marks it ready only after a rebuild from the new tip. If the rebuild fails, the PR stays a draft and cannot be merged. Re-run the failed `Release` workflow, and the PR becomes ready when it succeeds. A transient GitHub error during the rebuild is retried up to four times before it fails.

If a stale release PR was merged anyway, the release fails with [E165](errors.md) because the merge consumed no changesets, and every later push to `main` retries it. Nothing was published. Revert the merge's release payload (the version bumps, changelog entries and `.callisto/release-decision.json`, not the changeset files) in a pull request to `main`. The next push rebuilds the release PR from the changesets that are really pending.

## Recovering an older release

Recovering a commit that is no longer a branch tip may require these manual actions:

**E180: the workflow can't push tags.** GitHub rejects a `GITHUB_TOKEN` tag push when the tagged commit's workflows differ from every branch tip. Push every tag of the release yourself (PAT or deploy key), then dispatch the release for that SHA:

```sh
SHA=<release-source sha>
git tag -a "<tag>" -m "Release <tag>" "$SHA"   # each tag of the release
git push origin "<tag>"
gh workflow run callisto-release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha="$SHA"
```

**`ArtifactAssetDiffers`: rebuilt assets don't match.** Rebuilt tarballs aren't byte-identical. Delete the mismatched assets and dispatch again:

```sh
gh release delete-asset "<release tag>" "<asset>" --yes   # each mismatched asset
gh workflow run callisto-release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha="$SHA"
```

## Publication checks

Callisto checks the registry, remote tag, and GitHub release before each effect. An exact match is adopted; a conflict or uncertain result stops the run. Check the receipt and providers before treating a release as complete.

Registry checks confirm version presence, not identical bytes or the npm dist-tag. A Python release is complete only when every built wheel and sdist is on the index; a partly uploaded one is finished by uploading the missing files, and a sealed build also compares each file's digest. See [publishing limits](publishing.md#current-python-support-limits).

name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [__BRANCH__]

permissions: {}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  version-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: write, pull-requests: write}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@__COMMIT__ # callisto@__VERSION__
        with: {mode: version-pr, branch: __BRANCH__}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: read}
    outputs:
      release: ${{ steps.decision.outputs.release }}
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
      has_napi: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_napi }}
      napi_dirs: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.napi_dirs }}
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_artifacts }}
      has_python: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_python }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false}
      # Content precondition, not release detection: `release plan` requires this commit to write its decision.
      - name: Check for a release decision
        id: decision
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release=false
          if git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD^ > /dev/null &&
            git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only --diff-filter=AM -r HEAD^ HEAD | grep -qxF .callisto/release-decision.json; then
            release=true
          fi
          echo "release=$release" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - if: steps.decision.outputs.release == 'true'
        uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@__COMMIT__ # callisto@__VERSION__
        with: {version: callisto@__VERSION__}
      - name: Plan the release
        if: steps.decision.outputs.release == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent"
          callisto release plan --from-release-commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --decision .callisto/release-decision.json \
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
      - name: Build the matrix from napi targets and artifact slots
        id: matrix
        if: steps.decision.outputs.release == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          report="$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json"
          # Only packages in the release intent: an unrelated addon adds no build and cannot fail the plan.
          {
            while IFS= read -r package; do
              callisto --format json matrix --package "$package"
            done < <(jq -r '[.operations[].id.package] | unique[]' "$intent")
          } | jq -s '{platformTargets: (map(.platformTargets) | add // {})}' > "$report"
          napi=$(jq -c '[.platformTargets[] | select(.kind=="napi") | .targets[] | {kind: "napi"} + .]' "$report")
          slots=$(jq -c --slurpfile report "$report" '[.artifactSlots[] as $slot
            | ([$report[0].platformTargets[] | select(.kind=="cargo") | .targets[]
                | select(.artifactName == $slot.assetName and .triple == $slot.platform)] | first
              // error("callisto matrix has no entry for artifact slot \($slot.assetName)"))
            | {kind: "cargo"} + .]' "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json")
          {
            echo "matrix=$(jq -cn --argjson napi "$napi" --argjson slots "$slots" '$napi + $slots')"
            echo "has_napi=$(jq 'length > 0' <<< "$napi")"
            echo "napi_dirs=$(jq -c '[.[].packageDir] | unique' <<< "$napi")"
            echo "has_artifacts=$(jq 'length > 0' <<< "$slots")"
            echo "has_python=$(jq '[.operations[].id | select(.role.kind == "registryPublish" and (.package | startswith("pypi/")))] | length > 0' "$intent")"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - if: steps.decision.outputs.release == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error

  build:
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.matrix != '[]'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.hostRunner }}
    permissions: {contents: read, id-token: write, attestations: write}
    env:
      KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
      TRIPLE: ${{ matrix.triple }}
      USE_CROSS: ${{ matrix.useCross }}
      PACKAGE_DIR: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
      PACKAGE: ${{ matrix.packageName }}
      MANIFEST_PATH: ${{ matrix.manifestPath }}
      ASSET: ${{ matrix.artifactName }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {persist-credentials: false}
      - name: Install the Rust target
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rustup target add "$TRIPLE"
          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then cargo install cross --locked --version 0.2.5; fi
      - name: Build the napi addon
        if: matrix.kind == 'napi'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--platform --release --target "$TRIPLE" --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-out")
          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then args+=(--use-cross); fi
          if [[ -n "$MANIFEST_PATH" ]]; then args+=(--manifest-path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$MANIFEST_PATH"); fi
          (cd "${PACKAGE_DIR:-.}" && npx --yes --package @napi-rs/cli@3.10.4 napi build "${args[@]}")
      - if: matrix.kind == 'napi'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: napi-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/*.node
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Build and archive the release artifact
        if: matrix.kind == 'cargo'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo_bin=cargo
          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then cargo_bin=cross; fi
          cd "${PACKAGE_DIR:-.}"
          "$cargo_bin" build --release --locked --target "$TRIPLE" --package "$PACKAGE"
          metadata=$(cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1)
          target_dir=$(jq -r .target_directory <<< "$metadata")
          temp=$RUNNER_TEMP
          if command -v cygpath > /dev/null; then target_dir=$(cygpath -u "$target_dir"); temp=$(cygpath -u "$temp"); fi
          case "$TRIPLE" in *windows*) suffix=.exe ;; wasm32-*) suffix=.wasm ;; *) suffix= ;; esac
          stage="$temp/release-stage"
          out="$temp/release-assets"
          mkdir -p "$stage" "$out"
          jq -r --arg package "$PACKAGE" '.packages[] | select(.name == $package) | .targets[]
            | select(.kind | index("bin")) | .name' <<< "$metadata" | while IFS= read -r bin; do
            cp "$target_dir/$TRIPLE/release/$bin$suffix" "$stage/"
          done
          if [[ -z "$(ls -A "$stage")" ]]; then
            echo "::error::$PACKAGE builds no binary target for $TRIPLE"
            exit 1
          fi
          cd "$stage"
          case "$ASSET" in
            *.tar.gz | *.tgz) tar -czf "$out/$ASSET" ./* ;;
            *.tar.xz) tar -cJf "$out/$ASSET" ./* ;;
            *.zip) if command -v zip > /dev/null; then zip -q "$out/$ASSET" ./*; else 7z a -bd "$out/$ASSET" ./* > /dev/null; fi ;;
            *)
              binaries=(./*)
              if [[ ${#binaries[@]} -ne 1 ]]; then
                echo "::error::$ASSET is not an archive name, but $PACKAGE builds ${#binaries[@]} binaries"
                exit 1
              fi
              cp "${binaries[0]}" "$out/$ASSET"
              ;;
          esac
      - if: matrix.kind == 'cargo'
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets/${{ matrix.artifactName }}
      - if: matrix.kind == 'cargo'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: asset-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets/${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          if-no-files-found: error

  # No registry credentials: the executing job uploads these exact files.
  build-python:
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {contents: read}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@__COMMIT__ # callisto@__VERSION__
        with: {version: callisto@__VERSION__}
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - name: Build the Python distributions
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-venv"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-venv/bin/python" -m pip install --quiet __BUILD__
          export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/build-venv/bin:$PATH"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/python-dist"
          callisto release build-python --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" \
            --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/python-dist"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: python-dist
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/python-dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error

  execute:
    needs: [plan, build, build-python]
    # A skipped build blocks only when it had nothing to build.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' &&
      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.matrix == '[]')) &&
      (needs.build-python.result == 'success' || (needs.build-python.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_python != 'true'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: {group: callisto-release-execute, cancel-in-progress: false}
    permissions: {contents: write, id-token: write, attestations: read}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with: {fetch-depth: 0} # zizmor: ignore[artipacked] tag push needs persisted credentials
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@__COMMIT__ # callisto@__VERSION__
        with: {version: callisto@__VERSION__}
      - name: Install twine
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv/bin/python" -m pip install --quiet __TWINE__
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      # Downloads land under $RUNNER_TEMP: `release execute` requires a clean worktree.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: napi-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts
      - name: Place napi artifacts
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        env:
          NAPI_DIRS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dirs }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          jq -r '.[]' <<< "$NAPI_DIRS" | while IFS= read -r dir; do
            npx --yes --package @napi-rs/cli@3.10.4 napi artifacts --cwd "${dir:-.}" --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-artifacts"
          done
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: asset-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: python-dist
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets
      - name: Write the artifact manifest
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' || needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
        env:
          HAS_PYTHON: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_python }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets"
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json")
          if [[ "$HAS_PYTHON" == true ]]; then args+=(--seal-python); fi
          callisto release artifact-manifest "${args[@]}"
      - name: Execute the release
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt.json"
            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
        __RELEASE_ENV__

193	        with:

200	          "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-venv/bin/python" -m pip install --quiet __BUILD__
201	          export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/build-venv/bin:$PATH"
202	          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/python-dist"
203	          callisto release build-python --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" \

205	      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
206	        with:

212	    needs: [plan, build, build-python]
213	    # A skipped build blocks only when it had nothing to build.
214	    if: >-
215	      !cancelled() && needs.plan.outputs.release == 'true' &&
216	      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.matrix == '[]')) &&
217	      (needs.build-python.result == 'success' || (needs.build-python.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_python != 'true'))
218	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
219	    concurrency: {group: callisto-release-execute, cancel-in-progress: false}
220	    permissions: {contents: write, id-token: write, attestations: read}
221	    steps:
222	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
223	        with: {fetch-depth: 0} # zizmor: ignore[artipacked] tag push needs persisted credentials
224	      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@__COMMIT__ # callisto@__VERSION__
225	        with: {version: callisto@__VERSION__}
226	      - name: Install twine
227	        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
228	        run: |
229	          set -euo pipefail
230	          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv"
231	          "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv/bin/python" -m pip install --quiet __TWINE__
232	          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/publish-venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
233	      # Downloads land under $RUNNER_TEMP: `release execute` requires a clean worktree.
234	      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
235	        with:
236	          name: release-intent
237	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
238	      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
239	        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
240	        with:
241	          pattern: napi-*
242	          merge-multiple: true
243	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts
244	      - name: Place napi artifacts
245	        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
246	        env:
247	          NAPI_DIRS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dirs }}
248	        run: |
249	          set -euo pipefail
250	          jq -r '.[]' <<< "$NAPI_DIRS" | while IFS= read -r dir; do
251	            npx --yes --package @napi-rs/cli@3.10.4 napi artifacts --cwd "${dir:-.}" --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-artifacts"
252	          done
253	      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
254	        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
255	        with:
256	          pattern: asset-*
257	          merge-multiple: true
258	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets
259	      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
260	        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
261	        with:
262	          name: python-dist
263	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets
264	      - name: Write the artifact manifest
265	        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' || needs.plan.outputs.has_python == 'true'
266	        env:
267	          HAS_PYTHON: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_python }}
268	        run: |
269	          set -euo pipefail
270	          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets"
271	            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json")
272	          if [[ "$HAS_PYTHON" == true ]]; then args+=(--seal-python); fi
273	          callisto release artifact-manifest "${args[@]}"
274	      - name: Execute the release
275	        run: |
276	          set -euo pipefail
277	          args=(--intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt.json"
278	            --orchestration-revision "$GITHUB_SHA")
279	          if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" ]]; then
280	            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets")
281	          fi
282	          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
283	        __RELEASE_ENV__

name: 'Callisto Release-PR Action'
description: 'Creates or updates a Callisto release PR; durable execution belongs to the repository workflow'
inputs:
  version_command:
    description: 'Version command; defaults to callisto version, which refreshes lockfiles. Callisto appends --emit-decision <decision_path>.'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto version'
  decision_path:
    description: 'Path, relative to cwd, where the version command records the exact release decision this PR carries. Committed alongside the manifest and changelog edits; `callisto release plan --from-release-commit` verifies the merged commit against this file rather than re-deriving release policy.'
    required: false
    default: '.callisto/release-decision.json'
  commit_message:
    description: 'Release-PR commit message'
    required: false
    default: 'chore(release): version packages'
  title:
    description: 'Release-PR title'
    required: false
    default: 'chore(release): version packages'
  pr_label:
    description: 'Release-PR label'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto: release'
  branch:
    description: 'Base branch for the release PR'
    required: false
    default: 'main'
  release_branch:
    description: 'Branch managed for the release PR'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto/version-packages'
  github_token:
    description: 'Optional GitHub token for pull-request and forge commit API operations. The managed branch is never pushed with `git push`; the default GITHUB_TOKEN is sufficient even on a public repository, since the executor never writes `.github/workflows/*`.'
    required: false
    default: ''
  setup_callisto:
    description: 'Install the Callisto environment before running'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
  version:
    description: >-
      Version tag of Callisto to install. Default 'latest' installs the release this action's own
      invocation is pinned to (github.action_ref resolved against callisto@ tags), falling back to
      the newest published release when that ref is unset or unresolvable.
    required: false
    default: 'latest'
  cwd:
    description: 'Workspace directory'
    required: false
    default: '.'
  mode:
    description: 'version-pr (default): create/update the release PR. release: run `callisto release`.'
    required: false
    default: 'version-pr'
outputs:
  hasChangesets:
    description: 'Whether pending changesets were found (mode: version-pr only)'
    value: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}
  published:
    description: 'Whether `callisto release` published anything (mode: release only; otherwise false)'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.published || 'false' }}
  publishedPackages:
    description: 'JSON array of packages `callisto release` published (mode: release only; otherwise [])'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.publishedPackages || '[]' }}
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Validate mode
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/validate-mode.sh"
    # setup-callisto's own steps, called directly rather than through its
    # `uses:` (both `$/` and an external owner/repo/path@ref resolve against
    # whichever ref invoked *this* action, not necessarily a real one -- see
    # setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh's header). github.action_path
    # is this action's own checked-out directory, so a sibling-relative path
    # always uses the same ref this action itself was invoked at.
    - name: Install Rust Toolchain & Cache
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      # orin-dx/actions/setup-rust v1.1
      uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db
      with:
        components: clippy,rustfmt
        shared-key: "callisto-workspace-shared"
        save-if: "true"
      env:
        CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
        CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE: "true"
    - name: Install moon and the .prototools toolchain
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      # moonrepo/setup-toolchain v0
      uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095
      with:
        auto-install: true
    - name: Install or Build Callisto Binary
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE: auto
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION: fallback
        GITHUB_ACTION_REF: ${{ github.action_ref }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "${{ github.action_path }}/../setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh" # zizmor: ignore[github-env] the PATH entry is a fixed child of the trusted runner temporary directory, not action input or downloaded archive content.
    - name: Create or update release PR
      id: version-pr
      if: inputs.mode == 'version-pr'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND: ${{ inputs.version_command }}
        INPUT_DECISION_PATH: ${{ inputs.decision_path }}
        INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE: ${{ inputs.commit_message }}
        INPUT_TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}
        INPUT_PR_LABEL: ${{ inputs.pr_label }}
        INPUT_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
        INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.release_branch }}
        INPUT_CWD: ${{ inputs.cwd }}
        # GitHub exposes the installation token as a context, not a guaranteed
        # inherited environment variable. Using the context also works for the
        # repository workflow that invokes this action after checkout.
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh"
    - name: Run release
      id: release
      if: inputs.mode == 'release'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CWD: ${{ inputs.cwd }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/run-release.sh"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Installs or builds the Callisto binary. Factored out of action.yml so
3	# callisto-action's own environment setup can call it directly by path
4	# (github.action_path has no ref-ambiguous `uses:` to resolve), instead of
5	# duplicating this logic.
6	set -euo pipefail
7	
8	# Install into $RUNNER_TEMP so the binary never lands inside the workspace
9	# tree (preventing accidental git-staging by downstream steps that run
10	# "git add -A").
11	CALLISTO_BIN_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-bin"
12	mkdir -p "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR"
13	TAG_NAME="$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION"
14	SOURCE="$INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE"
15	
16	if [[ "$SOURCE" != "auto" && "$SOURCE" != "local" ]]; then
17	  echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto source '$SOURCE' (expected auto or local)"
18	  exit 1
19	fi
20	
21	# With no explicit version override, install the release this action's own
22	# invocation is pinned to (GITHUB_ACTION_REF, github.action_ref) rather than
23	# whatever is newest, so `callisto-action@<sha> # callisto@X.Y.Z` always
24	# installs X.Y.Z. Falls back to true "latest" when the ref is unset (local or
25	# unpinned invocation) or matches no published callisto@ tag; a failed tag
26	# lookup fails the step. A named ref such as the floating `v1` tag stands for
27	# the commit it points at.
28	if [[ "$SOURCE" == "auto" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" && -n "${GITHUB_ACTION_REF:-}" ]]; then
29	  if ! remote_tags=$(git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto.git 'callisto@*' "$GITHUB_ACTION_REF"); then
30	    echo "::error::could not list callisto release tags to resolve action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF; set the version input to install a specific release"
31	    exit 1
32	  fi
33	  ref_commit=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
34	    | awk -v ref="refs/tags/$GITHUB_ACTION_REF" '$2 == ref || $2 == ref "^{}" { sha = $1 } END { print sha }')
35	  resolved_tag=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
36	    | awk -v ref="${ref_commit:-$GITHUB_ACTION_REF}" '$1 == ref && $2 ~ /^refs\/tags\/callisto@/ { print $2 }' \
37	    | sed -e 's#^refs/tags/##' -e 's/\^{}$//' \

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Installs or builds the Callisto binary. Factored out of action.yml so
# callisto-action's own environment setup can call it directly by path
# (github.action_path has no ref-ambiguous `uses:` to resolve), instead of
# duplicating this logic.
set -euo pipefail

# Install into $RUNNER_TEMP so the binary never lands inside the workspace
# tree (preventing accidental git-staging by downstream steps that run
# "git add -A").
CALLISTO_BIN_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-bin"
mkdir -p "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR"
TAG_NAME="$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION"
SOURCE="$INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE"

if [[ "$SOURCE" != "auto" && "$SOURCE" != "local" ]]; then
  echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto source '$SOURCE' (expected auto or local)"
  exit 1
fi

# With no explicit version override, install the release this action's own
# invocation is pinned to (GITHUB_ACTION_REF, github.action_ref) rather than
# whatever is newest, so `callisto-action@<sha> # callisto@X.Y.Z` always
# installs X.Y.Z. Falls back to true "latest" when the ref is unset (local or
# unpinned invocation) or matches no published callisto@ tag; a failed tag
# lookup fails the step. A named ref such as the floating `v1` tag stands for
# the commit it points at.
if [[ "$SOURCE" == "auto" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" && -n "${GITHUB_ACTION_REF:-}" ]]; then
  if ! remote_tags=$(git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto.git 'callisto@*' "$GITHUB_ACTION_REF"); then
    echo "::error::could not list callisto release tags to resolve action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF; set the version input to install a specific release"
    exit 1
  fi
  ref_commit=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
    | awk -v ref="refs/tags/$GITHUB_ACTION_REF" '$2 == ref || $2 == ref "^{}" { sha = $1 } END { print sha }')
  resolved_tag=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
    | awk -v ref="${ref_commit:-$GITHUB_ACTION_REF}" '$1 == ref && $2 ~ /^refs\/tags\/callisto@/ { print $2 }' \
    | sed -e 's#^refs/tags/##' -e 's/\^{}$//' \
    | sort -V | tail -n1) || true
  if [[ -n "$resolved_tag" ]]; then
    echo "Resolved action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF to $resolved_tag"
    TAG_NAME="$resolved_tag"
  fi
fi

# Validate verification mode
VERIFICATION="${INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION:-fallback}"
case "$VERIFICATION" in
  require|fallback|skip) ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto verification '$VERIFICATION' (valid values: require, fallback, skip)"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

# Detect OS platform architecture for pre-built binaries
OS_NAME=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
ARCH_NAME=$(uname -m)

if [[ "$OS_NAME" == "darwin" ]]; then
  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
    arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
    *) ASSET_NAME="" ;;
  esac
elif [[ "$OS_NAME" == "linux" ]]; then
  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
    aarch64 | arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
    *) ASSET_NAME="" ;;
  esac
elif [[ "$OS_NAME" == *"mingw"* || "$OS_NAME" == *"msys"* || "$OS_NAME" == *"windows"* ]]; then
  ASSET_NAME=""
else
  ASSET_NAME=""
fi

if [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" ]]; then
  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/latest/download/$ASSET_NAME"
elif [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" ]]; then
  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/download/$TAG_NAME/$ASSET_NAME"
fi

# Derive a crates.io version spec from TAG_NAME: "latest" installs
# whatever crates.io resolves as latest (no --version flag); an
# explicit tag ("callisto@0.5.0" or legacy "callisto-cli@0.5.0")
# strips either prefix down to the bare semver cargo install expects.
CRATE_VERSION="${TAG_NAME#callisto@}"; CRATE_VERSION="${CRATE_VERSION#callisto-cli@}"

# Pick a download destination whose extension matches ASSET_NAME
# (under $RUNNER_TEMP, never the workspace) so the extraction step
# below always has an archive it can actually open -- a hardcoded
# ".tar.gz" path here previously masked the fact that Windows assets
# are zip files, since tar -xzf can't read a zip regardless of what
# the file on disk is really named.
case "$ASSET_NAME" in
  *.zip)
    DOWNLOAD_DEST="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto.zip"
    ;;
  *.tar.gz)
    DOWNLOAD_DEST="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto.tar.gz"
    ;;
  *)
    DOWNLOAD_DEST="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto.tar.gz"
    ;;
esac

# A prebuilt asset runs with the job's privileges, so it must carry a
# GitHub attestation from the Callisto release workflow before it is
# extracted. require aborts on failure; fallback discards the asset and
# returns 1 so the crates.io path runs; skip trusts the asset.
verify_asset() {
  local reason=""
  if [[ "$VERIFICATION" == "skip" ]]; then
    echo "::warning::verification=skip: $ASSET_NAME was not verified"
    return 0
  fi
  if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    reason="gh is not installed"
  elif ! gh attestation verify "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" \
      --repo orin-dx/callisto \
      --signer-workflow orin-dx/callisto/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml \
      --deny-self-hosted-runners; then
    reason="attestation verification failed"
  fi
  [[ -z "$reason" ]] && return 0
  rm -f "$DOWNLOAD_DEST"
  if [[ "$VERIFICATION" == "require" ]]; then
    echo "::error::cannot verify $ASSET_NAME: $reason (verification=require)"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "::warning::cannot verify $ASSET_NAME: $reason; discarding it and installing from crates.io (verification=fallback)"
  return 1
}

# Download, verify and extract the prebuilt asset; nonzero means use the fallback chain.
fetch_prebuilt() {
  curl -sL -f "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" 2>/dev/null || return 1
  verify_asset || return 1
  # Extract only the expected binary, never the whole archive.
  case "$ASSET_NAME" in
    *.zip)
      unzip -q "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" callisto.exe -d "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR"
      ;;
    *)
      tar -xzf "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" -C "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" callisto
      ;;
  esac
}

# Dependencies named callisto-cli do not establish checkout source ownership.
owns_local_source() {
  local workspace git_root metadata
  workspace=$(cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" && pwd -P) || return 1
  git_root=$(git -C "$workspace" rev-parse --show-toplevel) || return 1
  [[ "$git_root" == "$workspace" ]] || return 1
  git -C "$workspace" ls-files --error-unmatch -- \
    Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs >/dev/null || return 1
  metadata=$(cargo metadata --locked --offline --no-deps --format-version 1 \
    --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml") || return 1
  jq -e --arg workspace "$workspace" '
    .workspace_root == $workspace and
    (.workspace_members as $members | [.packages[] |
      select(.name == "callisto-cli" and .source == null and
        .manifest_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml") and
        (.id as $id | $members | index($id) != null) and
        any(.targets[]; .name == "callisto" and (.kind | index("bin") != null) and
          .src_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs")))] | length == 1)
  ' <<< "$metadata" >/dev/null
}

if [[ "$SOURCE" == "local" ]]; then
  if ! owns_local_source; then
    echo "::error::setup-callisto source=local requires a Callisto workspace checkout; check out Callisto source or use source=auto"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Building local callisto binary from current repository commit..."
  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-cli \
    --bin callisto --target-dir "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target"
  cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/debug/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
elif [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" ]] && fetch_prebuilt; then
  echo "Callisto downloaded from GitHub Releases ($DOWNLOAD_URL)"
elif [[ "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" ]] && cargo install callisto-cli --locked --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install" --quiet; then
  echo "Callisto installed from crates.io (latest)"
  cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
elif [[ "$TAG_NAME" != "latest" ]] && cargo install callisto-cli --version "$CRATE_VERSION" --locked --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install" --quiet; then
  echo "Callisto installed from crates.io ($CRATE_VERSION)"
  cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
else
  echo "::error::callisto $TAG_NAME is available neither as a prebuilt asset nor on crates.io"
  exit 1
fi

echo "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" >> $GITHUB_PATH
if [[ -f "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json" ]]; then
  echo "::add-matcher::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runs `callisto release` (mode: release) and fills published/publishedPackages
# from its receipt; callisto release's own idempotency makes a redundant run a no-op.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$INPUT_CWD"

runtime_dir="$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/callisto-release.XXXXXX")"
receipt="$runtime_dir/release-receipt.json"
cleanup() {
  rm -f "$runtime_dir/npmrc" "$receipt"
  rmdir "$runtime_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [[ -n "${NPM_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  npm_config="${NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG:-${HOME:-}/.npmrc}"
  if [[ -n "${HOME:-}" && -f "$npm_config" ]]; then
    cp "$npm_config" "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  else
    : > "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  fi
  chmod 600 "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  printf '\n//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}\n' >> "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  export CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG="$runtime_dir/npmrc"
fi

if [[ -n "${PYPI_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  export TWINE_USERNAME=__token__
  export TWINE_PASSWORD="$PYPI_TOKEN"
  unset PYPI_TOKEN
fi

output=$(callisto --format json release --receipt "$receipt")

if jq -e '.nothingToRelease == true' <<< "$output" > /dev/null; then
  echo 'published=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo 'publishedPackages=[]' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo '::notice::Nothing to release.'
  exit 0
fi

packages=$(jq -c '[
    .outcomes[]
    | select(.outcome.kind == "published" and (.operation.role.kind == "registryPublish" or .operation.role.kind == "platformPublish"))
    | .operation.package
  ] | unique' "$receipt")
published=$(jq -r 'length > 0' <<< "$packages")
{
  echo "published=$published"
  echo "publishedPackages=$packages"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# Fails fast when callisto-action's `mode` input is not one of its two accepted values.
set -euo pipefail

case "$INPUT_MODE" in
  version-pr|release) ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::callisto-action mode must be 'version-pr' or 'release', got '$INPUT_MODE'"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

2	# Installs or builds the Callisto binary. Factored out of action.yml so
3	# callisto-action's own environment setup can call it directly by path
4	# (github.action_path has no ref-ambiguous `uses:` to resolve), instead of
5	# duplicating this logic.
6	set -euo pipefail
7	
8	# Install into $RUNNER_TEMP so the binary never lands inside the workspace
9	# tree (preventing accidental git-staging by downstream steps that run
10	# "git add -A").
11	CALLISTO_BIN_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-bin"

13	TAG_NAME="$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION"
14	SOURCE="$INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE"
15	
16	if [[ "$SOURCE" != "auto" && "$SOURCE" != "local" ]]; then
17	  echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto source '$SOURCE' (expected auto or local)"
18	  exit 1
19	fi
20	
21	# With no explicit version override, install the release this action's own
22	# invocation is pinned to (GITHUB_ACTION_REF, github.action_ref) rather than
23	# whatever is newest, so `callisto-action@<sha> # callisto@X.Y.Z` always
24	# installs X.Y.Z. Falls back to true "latest" when the ref is unset (local or
25	# unpinned invocation) or matches no published callisto@ tag; a failed tag
26	# lookup fails the step. A named ref such as the floating `v1` tag stands for
27	# the commit it points at.
28	if [[ "$SOURCE" == "auto" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" && -n "${GITHUB_ACTION_REF:-}" ]]; then
29	  if ! remote_tags=$(git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto.git 'callisto@*' "$GITHUB_ACTION_REF"); then
30	    echo "::error::could not list callisto release tags to resolve action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF; set the version input to install a specific release"
31	    exit 1
32	  fi
33	  ref_commit=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
34	    | awk -v ref="refs/tags/$GITHUB_ACTION_REF" '$2 == ref || $2 == ref "^{}" { sha = $1 } END { print sha }')
35	  resolved_tag=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
36	    | awk -v ref="${ref_commit:-$GITHUB_ACTION_REF}" '$1 == ref && $2 ~ /^refs\/tags\/callisto@/ { print $2 }' \
37	    | sed -e 's#^refs/tags/##' -e 's/\^{}$//' \
38	    | sort -V | tail -n1) || true
39	  if [[ -n "$resolved_tag" ]]; then
40	    echo "Resolved action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF to $resolved_tag"
41	    TAG_NAME="$resolved_tag"
42	  fi
43	fi
44	
45	# Validate verification mode
46	VERIFICATION="${INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION:-fallback}"
47	case "$VERIFICATION" in
48	  require|fallback|skip) ;;
49	  *)
50	    echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto verification '$VERIFICATION' (valid values: require, fallback, skip)"
51	    exit 1
52	    ;;
53	esac
54	
55	# Detect OS platform architecture for pre-built binaries
56	OS_NAME=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
57	ARCH_NAME=$(uname -m)
58	
59	if [[ "$OS_NAME" == "darwin" ]]; then
60	  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
61	    arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
62	    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
63	    *) ASSET_NAME="" ;;
64	  esac
65	elif [[ "$OS_NAME" == "linux" ]]; then
66	  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
67	    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
68	    aarch64 | arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
69	    *) ASSET_NAME="" ;;
70	  esac
71	elif [[ "$OS_NAME" == *"mingw"* || "$OS_NAME" == *"msys"* || "$OS_NAME" == *"windows"* ]]; then
72	  ASSET_NAME=""
73	else
74	  ASSET_NAME=""
75	fi
76	
77	if [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" ]]; then
78	  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/latest/download/$ASSET_NAME"
79	elif [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" ]]; then
80	  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/download/$TAG_NAME/$ASSET_NAME"
81	fi
82	
83	# Derive a crates.io version spec from TAG_NAME: "latest" installs
84	# whatever crates.io resolves as latest (no --version flag); an

87	CRATE_VERSION="${TAG_NAME#callisto@}"; CRATE_VERSION="${CRATE_VERSION#callisto-cli@}"
